claim: In July 2026 TSMC said it expects the steep ramp-up of its 2nm technology to dilute gross margin by about 3 to 4 percentage points in the second half of 2026.
evidence: "First, we expect a steep ramp-up of our 2-nanometer to dilute our gross margin by about 3 to 4 percentage points in the second half of the year." (CFO Wendell Huang, key messages, 2Q26 call, 16 Jul 2026)

metric.name: TSMC 2nm-ramp gross-margin dilution guidance, 2H26 (July 2026)
metric.population: Company gross margin impact of N2 ramp

notes: Replaces the Jan/Apr 2026 full-year framing (2-3% for FY2026, CLM-2108); no full-year 2nm figure was restated in July. Do not convert to a full-year number without TSMC saying so.

claim: TechInsights' Dan Hutcheson (2025), citing the Strategic Cost and Price Model, said it costs TSMC less than 10% more to process a 300mm wafer in Arizona than the same wafer in Taiwan.
evidence: "The final answer was: It costs TSMC less than 10% more to process a 300mm wafer in Arizona than the same wafer made in Taiwan." (The Chip Insider, TSMC's True Cost: Arizona versus Taiwan)

metric.name: Arizona vs Taiwan TSMC wafer cost premium (2025 model)
metric.population: Same 300mm wafer processed by TSMC; fab size and node not stated in the public summary
metric.methodology: TechInsights Strategic Cost and Price Model (developed by Scotten Jones); details paywalled

notes: Same model family as IC Knowledge's 2021 estimate (CLM-2097: 7% same-size, 17% incl. small-fab penalty). Public blog summary only.

claim: TechInsights' Dan Hutcheson (2025) said labour accounts for less than 2% of total wafer costs in today's highly automated fabs, even though US-Taiwan labour cost differences are roughly 200%.
evidence: "Where most make their mistakes is with direct and indirect labor cost differences. While there is roughly a 200% difference between the US and Taiwan. This is a head fake because today's fabs are so automated. Labor accounts for less than 2% of total costs."

metric.name: Labour share of leading-edge wafer cost (direct + indirect)
metric.population: Direct and indirect labour, leading-edge 300mm fab
metric.methodology: TechInsights Strategic Cost and Price Model; details paywalled

claim: TechInsights' Dan Hutcheson (2025) said well over two-thirds of wafer cost is in the equipment, which is why the Arizona-Taiwan cost gap is small.
evidence: "It's equipment that levels the playing field. Well over two-thirds of wafer cost is in the equipment. That's why the overall wafer cost difference between Arizona and Taiwan comes in at just under 10%."

metric.name: Equipment share of wafer cost
metric.unit: % of wafer cost (lower bound; 'well over two-thirds')
metric.methodology: TechInsights Strategic Cost and Price Model; details paywalled
